authorityOrder: Session 1 initial canonical Study Engine v1 boundary
Tutor Core v0.2 for instructional and tutoring authority
Session 2 for pacing algorithms after adapters
Session 3 for Student UX and accessibility
Session 4 for calendar, review queue, parent insights, and Romeo adapter

decision.tutorCoreRule: Use the package ID and exact version from the actual v0.2 manifest; never synthesize either value. The package record stays unapproved until the artifact is accessible and hash-verified.

rules: Maximum 128 characters at the canonical boundary
Never derive from names, email, grade, dates, array positions, or titles
Never normalize case, separators, or legacy values
Cross-kind use is rejected at compile time and by aggregate validation
decision.idempotencyScope: StudySessionEvent.id is unique within sessionId; same ID and same canonical payload is a no-op, same ID with a different payload is a conflict and quarantine.
decision.externalReferences: When a provisional consumer cannot accept a valid canonical ID, use a reversible lookup table rather than lossy rewriting.

decision.exactGradeRule: Exact grade is optional planning metadata, never identity, birthdate, age, mastery, or placement.
decision.validationRule: The extension requires its own registered namespace validator before final assembly.
decision.legacyRule: Map only the closed legacy values 3, 4, 6, 10, and 12 with gradeBandFromLegacyGrade; do not infer other grades.

decisions.topic: Canonical subject, skill, and task IDs

decision.subject: SubjectId
decision.noParallelTaskId: Do not add a second TaskId for a planned task instance. SegmentId is the stable task-instance identity; taskType is classification only.

decision.persistenceRule: Only Session 1 StudySessionEvent values are persisted in StudySession.eventLog.
decision.adapterRule: Session 2 orchestrator events and Session 3 UX events are commands/intents; Session 4 events are projection audit events. None is dual-persisted as a parallel learning event.
decision.requiredChange: Add and test one exhaustive canonical transition reducer; current aggregate validation does not prove every intermediate transition.

decision.eventVersion: Embedded events inherit StudySession.schemaVersion 1; do not add a duplicate domain field.
decision.idempotencyKey: Use caller-stable command idempotency keys. For a one-event append, StudySessionEvent.id is the default key scoped by sessionId.
decision.retryRule: Same key plus byte-equivalent canonical command returns the prior result; same key plus different content is an idempotency conflict and is quarantined.
decision.sequenceRule: Event sequence is contiguous and monotonic. Multi-event commands allocate their range atomically under expected aggregate revision.
decision.projectionRule: Calendar dedupeKey and review occurrence identity are logical projection keys, not replacements for event idempotency.

decision.draftRule: responseDraftRef points to a separately authorized local draft vault. Raw draft content never enters the cursor, event log, evidence, manifest, or projections.
decision.restoreRule: Reject or quarantine stale/forged cursors when session, plan, segment, event sequence, revision, or opaque integrity token does not match.

decision.separationRule: breakType is the pacing activity; reasonCategory is origin/authority. Keep both and never treat them as duplicate enums.
decision.neutralityRule: Approved breaks never count as failure.

allowedContent: opaque evidence, session, subject, and skill references
decision.mappingRule: Session 2 aggregate signals may populate only matching evidence measures. They cannot populate mastery, misconception, prerequisite, or instructional authority.

decision.studyEngineRole: Store a validated projection with opaque source outcome reference, algorithm/version provenance, and basis EvidenceIds; do not calculate or rename Tutor Core meaning.
decision.provisionalValues: Session 1 status values are storage projection candidates, not proof of compatibility.
decision.blockedMapping: Exact enum, uncertainty, misconception, prerequisite, retention, and adult-review mapping requires the actual Tutor Core package.

decision.rule: Only increase|maintain|decrease may create an actionable RecommendationId. insufficient_data and manual_review are terminal non-actionable dispositions.
decision.decisionScope: Acceptance or rejection applies to one RecommendationId. It is never converted into an unbounded standing allowIncrease flag.

decisions.topic: Parent and teacher controls and override precedence

decision.proposedOrderVerdict: REPLACE SIMPLE FIRST-WINS CHAIN WITH CONSTRAINT REDUCTION
constraintOrder: most restrictive active authorized adult hard maximum
current unexpired authorized parent or teacher explicit override
algorithm: Compute lowerBound as the maximum of all applicable hard minimums.
Compute upperBound as the minimum of safety, required accommodation, and parent hard maxima.
If lowerBound is greater than upperBound, emit manual_review and no automatic target.
Choose the first candidate target from active explicit override, engine recommendation, established target, or grade default.
Clamp the candidate to the feasible interval and record every applied constraint and winning provenance.
Manual override may hold or reduce but never exceed a higher hard bound.
Required breaks and presentation accommodations are obligations, not numeric candidates.
A rejection suppresses only the referenced RecommendationId.
Conflicting concurrent adult overrides never use implicit last-write-wins; reject the stale revision or route to manual_review.

decision.rule: Never parse free-form functionalDescription into machine constraints. Projections share one AccommodationId and are not independently editable.
decision.coreGate: Actual Tutor Core media, board, spoken-turn, caption, and transcript fields must be mapped before approval.

decision.sameDayRule: same-day means the same learner-local calendar date, never an immediate retry. A retrieval failure requires authorized support or reteaching plus a completed break/session boundary before another attempt.
decision.automaticPlacementRule: A date-only recommendation does not invent a time of day. An authorized scheduler or adult supplies a slot within the reviewed retry window and daily limits.
decision.blocker: No verified package defines a safe same-day not-before instant; automatic same-day retry timing remains manual_review until Tutor Core/policy review.

decisions.topic: Household IANA timezone and learner-local dates

decision.sourceOfTruth: One authorized HouseholdCalendarContext supplies an IANA timeZone.
decision.localDateRule: Derive learner-local dates from an offset-qualified instant plus the authorized zone, then persist both localDate and zoneIdUsed.
decision.historyRule: A later household-zone change does not recompute historical local dates.
decision.travelRule: Travel or temporary-zone behavior requires an explicit effective-dated override.

decision.identity: Calendar blocks keep canonical SegmentId values; entryId and dedupeKey are projection identities only.
decision.customRule: StudyTaskType custom requires an explicit reviewed calendar block type. Never guess from title.
decision.dateRule: Date-only review or due dates require separately supplied scheduledStart with explicit offset and intendedLocalDate validation.
decision.completionRule: Canonical segment completion drives calendar projection; calendar completion never declares learning mastery.

flow: mark occurrence and calendar work complete
decision.consistency: Use an idempotent outbox/saga; projection failure never rolls back or duplicates canonical learning evidence.
decision.requiredChange: Session 4 needs a completeReview/result API with ReviewId, occurrence ID, SessionId, EvidenceId, RetrievalAttemptId, and idempotency key.

decision.progressRule: Keep parent and student entered progress separate; external completed state wins only when explicitly supplied.
decision.supportRule: Promote linked support to VersionedReference<StudyPlanId> unless the actual Tutor Core package exposes a more specific support reference. Derive available/requested/completed from plan/session lifecycle; do not persist a drifting duplicate state.
decision.dueDateRule: Keep dueDate as a calendar date in parent projections. Do not synthesize dueAt midnight.
decision.credentialRule: No login, username, password, token, cookie, API key, or credential-bearing URL is accepted.

decision.storage: ParentTeacherPrivateRecord in a separately authorized adult-private repository
decision.studentProjection: No body, excerpt, category, or existence flag unless an explicit adult-authorized product requirement is later approved.

allowedReferences: opaque Tutor Core outcome/evidence/transcript references when authorized
decision.uiRule: Entered work needed for exact resume may remain in a separate device-local vault; it is never copied into Study Engine events, evidence, logs, or reconciliation artifacts.
decision.tutorRule: Tutor Core remains the only authority for its transcript and adult-review evidence retention; the Study Engine receives references or minimized projections only.
decision.metadataRule: Student-safe tags and namespaced extension values are allowlisted by schema and data class. A valid namespace is not permission to carry arbitrary strings or sensitive content.

decision.boundaryRule: Every ingress is unknown until version inspection and registry validation succeeds.
decision.extensionRule: Each promoted integration, command, recommendation, resume cursor, and review occurrence receives one registered schema; unregistered kinds are quarantined.

decision.repository: Versioned Study Engine sidecar; no insertion into Tutor Core or production profile state
decision.events: Append-only with per-session contiguous sequence and idempotency index
decision.projections: Calendar, queue, parent, and Romeo are rebuildable sidecars driven through idempotent outbox records
decision.atomicity: Canonical aggregate plus outbox commit atomically; external projection completion may retry independently.
decision.deletion: Retention/deletion policy is explicit and category-specific; event rewriting is forbidden.

decision.rule: The updater receives the latest committed value; callers never submit a precomputed replacement based on render-time state.
decision.conflict: Revision mismatch returns a typed conflict and does not retry with a stale precomputed object.
decision.projectionHook: enqueueProjection(previousOutbox, command) is part of the same functional update.

decision.rule: No fallback-to-empty, best-effort coercion, or future-version acceptance.
decision.loggingRule: Operational logs contain quarantine metadata and fixed diagnostics only, never the quarantined raw payload.

decision.assemblyRule: One authorized workspace lockfile and one TypeScript project graph; no package-manager or source rewrite in this audit.

runtimeLayers.contractsAlgorithms: No React, DOM, jsdom, Playwright, or network runtime dependency
runtimeLayers.browserUx: React and React DOM only at runtime
runtimeLayers.tests: Vitest, Testing Library, jsdom, Axe, and Playwright remain test-only

decision.moduleRule: Compile through the workspace bundler/project graph. Retire mixed .ts/.js source-import conventions during authorized assembly with parity tests.
decision.typeRule: Align @types/node with the selected assembly runtime before final assembly; current prototype pins major 22 while validation ran on Node 24.

decision.dedupeKey: requested capability plus authoritative owner, not source-session request number
decision.rule: One consolidated request may cite many Wave 1 requests; no duplicate request remains open under a different label.
